name: Delphi World Money Limited
summary: Operating primarily within India, Ebixcash World Money India Limited specializes in a comprehensive range of financial services, including currency exchange and money transfer solutions. The company's offerings extend to facilitating both inward and outward international remittances, providing prepaid and gift cards, and offering travel insurance, catering to a diverse clientele of corporate and retail customers. Established in Mumbai in 1985, the firm operated as Weizmann Forex Limited until January 2020, when it rebranded under its current name. It functions as a subsidiary of EbixCash World Money Limited.
